source_files: ArA label/val.csv (ara.zip from the MM-AU release)
note: One example is one video's metadata entry (scene attributes, accident window as frame indices t_ai/t_co/t_ae, and the text description, cause and prevention measure) plus, when it exists, its accident-reason multiple-choice row. ArA rows name videos as <type>-<zero-padded number> (43-001315); we matched this to metadata video_name 43_1315, and the frame counts agree (79). The release gives frame indices without a frame rate in these files, so the timeline is left empty. No media: videos ship only as 525 GB of chunked archives.

examples.title: 1_1: pedestrian crossing, accident frames 30–115, collision at 63

7950b19f.causes: Pedestrian does not notice the coming vehicles when crossing the street
7950b19f.measures: When passing the zebra crossing, drivers must slow down. When pedestrians or non-motor vehicles cross the zebra crossing, they should stop and give way to other normal running vehicles; When crossing the road, pedestrians must follow the zebra crossing, carefully observe the traffic, and do not cross the road in a hurry.

examples.title: 43_1315: evasive action, accident frames 16-49 of 79 + ArA cause question (answer a1 "drives too fast")
